messages.subject: Simple Within-App Password Activation?
parts:
Hello, I am new to Shiny and am trying to require a password ("Hello" for now) to 'activate' a simple Shiny app.  I have a basic setup working with this code:

#install.packages("shiny")
#require(shiny)
#library(shiny)

shiny::runApp(list( 
  ui = pageWithSidebar(

    headerPanel("Password Test"),

    sidebarPanel(
id="sb",
      textInput("pw", "Enter password to activate", value="")
),

    mainPanel(
      conditionalPanel(        
condition="input.pw != 'Hello'",
        h4('Must enter correct password')
      ),
conditionalPanel(
        condition="input.pw == 'Hello'",
     plotOutput("distPlot")
      )
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {

    output$distPlot = renderPlot(plot(cars))
  }
)
)    

However, I would also like to hide the 'password' form once the correct password has been entered and I am having trouble making this part work with the code above.

While I would not want to use the code below in the final app because the password is included in the source code, I am trying to make sure I have the JavaScript right:

#install.packages("shiny")
#require(shiny)
#library(shiny)

shiny::runApp(list( 
  ui = bootstrapPage(
  tagList(singleton(tags$head(tags$script(type = "text/javascript", 'window.onload = function() {
            document.getElementById("sb").style.display = "block";
        }
        function textCheck() {
            if (document.getElementById("pw").value == "Hello") {
                hideForm();
            } else {
                showForm();
                document.getElementById("pw").value = "";
                //This is for clear the text in text field.
            }
        }
        function hideForm() {
            document.getElementById("sb").style.display = "none";
        }
        function showForm() {
            document.getElementById("sb").style.display = "block";
        }
')))),
    headerPanel("Password Test"),
    sidebarPanel(
id="sb",
 HTML('<label for="pw">Enter password to activate</label><input id="pw" value="" onchange="textCheck()"></input>')
),

    mainPanel(
      conditionalPanel(        
condition="input.pw != 'Hello'",
        h4('Must enter correct password')
      ),
conditionalPanel(
        condition="input.pw == 'Hello'",
     plotOutput("distPlot")
      )
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {

    output$distPlot = renderPlot(plot(cars))
  }
)
)


As one more alternative, I've also tried changing the input field type to 'hidden' from 'text' in case the Shiny condition was failing because hiding the form prevented Shiny from checking the value of the input field, but this is still not working for me.

#install.packages("shiny")
#require(shiny)
#library(shiny)

shiny::runApp(list( 
  ui = bootstrapPage(
  tagList(singleton(tags$head(tags$script(type = "text/javascript", 'window.onload = function() {
            document.getElementById("pw").type = "text";
        }
        function textCheck() {
            if (document.getElementById("pw").value == "Hello") {
                hideForm();
            } else {
                showForm();
                document.getElementById("pw").value = "";
                //This is for clear the text in text field.
            }
        }
        function hideForm() {
            document.getElementById("pw").type = "hidden";
        }
        function showForm() {
            document.getElementById("pw").type = "text";
        }
')))),
    headerPanel("Password Test"),
    sidebarPanel(
id="sb",
 HTML('<label for="pw">Enter password to activate</label><input id="pw" value="" onchange="textCheck()"></input>')
),

    mainPanel(
      conditionalPanel(        
condition="input.pw != 'Hello'",
        h4('Must enter correct password')
      ),
conditionalPanel(
        condition="input.pw == 'Hello'",
     plotOutput("distPlot")
      )
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {

    output$distPlot = renderPlot(plot(cars))
  }
)
)

Based on the functionality of the second block of code, it does not seem that the conditions in the conditionalPanel portions of the code are playing nicely with the other parts of the code.  Could anyone help me figure this out, so that entering the correct password both displays the content (a simple scatterplot) and hides the input form?  Thank you!
